about: The Thread's presentation contract, shared by the Android app (android/.../core/ThreadView.kt, ThreadGoldenTest) and the web companion. Each case is the wire ThreadEntry list the office sends (src/shared/worker-thread.ts) and the rows a platform shows for it. Change the fixture and both projections together.

schema.case: { name: string (unique), busy: boolean (the worker is in a turn), entries: ThreadEntry[] (wire shape, oldest first), expected: Row[] }
schema.message: { kind: 'message', id: entry id, role: 'user' | 'assistant', startsTurn: boolean (first assistant message after the owner's, or the first one: the only one that carries the worker's name) }
schema.notice: { kind: 'notice', id: entry id, text: string (the copy shown), tone: 'quiet' | 'danger' | 'attachment' }
schema.activity: { kind: 'activity', id: 'activity:' + first raw entry id of the run (hidden ones included), summary: string (the closed line), live: boolean (newest run while busy), items: Item[] (shown actions and thoughts, in order), failed: string[] (titles of failed actions, shown even closed), noResult: number, plan: PlanStep[] | null (the run's latest plan only when it changed since the last one shown; never a row) }
schema.action: { type: 'action', id: entry id, title: string (human, never a raw command, JSON or absolute home path), detail: string | null (quiet secondary line: a short path, pattern, subagent type, or a command shortened only when there is no summary), state: 'done' | 'running' | 'failed' | 'no_result' | 'cancelled' }
schema.thought: { type: 'thought', id: entry id, preview: string (first non-blank line, ** trimmed) }
rules: A run is every consecutive tool, thinking and todo entry between messages and shown notices; a run with nothing to show leaves no row.

Hidden when they succeed: TodoWrite, TodoRead, ToolSearch, Skill, WaitForScript, TaskOutput, and a Script followed by any tool call (bookkeeping included) before the next Script or the end of the run. A failed one of any of them is always shown, with its exact failure title ("Couldn't read script results", "Couldn't read task output", ...).

A failed Script with the CLI's exact error envelope repeating an enclosed child's full failure stays available as diagnostics but is excluded from the summary and failed count. Independent, unmatched, truncated or incomplete wrapper failures remain counted.
A Script with no tool call after it (before the next Script or the end of the run) stays as 'Ran a script' (its source and result in its details).
TaskStop and Loop are shown: 'Stopped a background task' / 'Couldn't stop the background task', 'Scheduled a loop' / 'Couldn't schedule the loop'.

Todo snapshots are never rows. A run's latest plan goes on its own activity; a run with no row passes its plan on to the next activity shown (even past a message), and a plan counts as shown only once an activity carries it.

Turn ended · completed is hidden; Turn cancelled is a quiet notice. A cancellation error in the run immediately preceding that notice is cancelled, not failed; genuine earlier errors stay failed. Activity.cancelled counts those cancelled actions when nonzero. Any other ending is a danger notice in words.
A call with no output is 'running' only in the live run; otherwise 'no_result'. Never 'done' without output.

summary: verb phrases per kind in first-seen order, Read counts match the visible calls (including repeated reads); edited and created files are unique. Then 'N more' actions past three kinds; failed bookkeeping isn't counted; 'Thought' for a run of only thoughts.
